places.name: Erasmus Bridge
places.ai_summary: An iconic cable-stayed bridge connecting the north and south of Rotterdam, offering stunning views of the city skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Capture the bridge illuminated at night for a spectacular photo.

places.name: SS Rotterdam
places.ai_summary: A former ocean liner turned hotel and museum, offering a glimpse into the luxurious past of transatlantic travel.

attribution.title: Rotterdam, Laurenskerk, na bombardement van mei 1940
attribution.author: Unknown authorUnknown author
attribution.description: "The German ultimatum ordering the Dutch commander of Rotterdam to cease fire was delivered to him at 10:30h on 14 May 1940. At 13:22h, German bombers set the whole inner city of Rotterdam ablaze, killing 814 of its inhabitants." The photo was taken after the removal of all debris.

places.name: Fenix Food Factory
places.ai_summary: A trendy food hall in a former warehouse, featuring a variety of local food vendors, shops, and a brewery.

places.place_tip: Check the feeding times for a more interactive experience.
